t: With the Dialing Device you can link a $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_transmitter)Matter Transmitter$(/l) to a $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_receiver)Matter Receiver$(/l). Note that the Matter Transmitter has to be nearby but the Matter Receiver can be very far away (even in another dimension)$(br2)$(5)Infusing$() this machine reduces power usage
使用坐标记录仪，你可将$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_transmitter)物质传输器$(/l)链接至$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_receiver)物质接收器$(/l)。注意：物质传输器需位于附近，而物质接收器则可远在千里之外（甚至处于另一维度）$(br2)$(5)注魔$()该机器可降低能耗。

To dial you first have to select a Matter Transmitter. If there is only one nearby then it will be automatically selected. After that you have to select a Matter Receiver (in the bottom list) and chose either 'Dial' or 'Dial Once'. With 'Dial Once' the connection will be interrupted as soon as someone teleports
要进行拨号，你首先必须选择一个物质传输器。如果附近只有一个，它会被自动选中。之后你必须选择一个物质接收器（在底部列表中），然后选择“拨号”或“单次拨号”。使用“单次拨号”时，一旦有人传送，连接就会中断。
